*{box-sizing:border-box}
:root{color-scheme:light dark;--bg:#fff;--canvas:#f6f8fa;--text:#1f2328;--muted:#656d76;--line:#d0d7de;--softline:#d8dee4;--code:#f6f8fa;--link:#0969da;--del:#82071e;--add:#116329;--delbg:#ffebe9;--addbg:#dafbe1}

body{margin:0;background:var(--canvas);color:var(--text);font:16px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;padding:26px}
.shell{max-width:988px;margin:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden}
.chrome{padding:13px 30px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font:12px/1.5 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;color:var(--muted)}

article{padding:32px;overflow-wrap:break-word}
article>:first-child{margin-top:0!important} article>:last-child{margin-bottom:0!important}
p,pre,blockquote,table,details{margin:0 0 16px}p:empty{display:none}
picture{display:block;margin:0 0 15px}picture img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-width:100%}

h2 img{vertical-align:-3px;margin-right:5px}
strong{font-weight:600}
a{color:var(--link);text-decoration:none} a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
sub{font-size:12px;bottom:-.25em;color:var(--muted)}
blockquote{padding:0 1em;color:var(--muted);border-left:.25em solid var(--line)} blockquote p{margin-bottom:0}blockquote strong{color:var(--text)}
pre{padding:16px;font:13px/1.45 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,'Liberation Mono',monospace;background:var(--code);border-radius:6px;overflow-x:auto;word-wrap:normal}
code{font:inherit}pre code{display:block;min-width:max-content}
.diff-del{background:var(--delbg);color:var(--del)}.diff-add{background:var(--addbg);color:var(--add)}
details summary{cursor:pointer;list-style-position:inside}details[open] summary{margin-bottom:14px}
hr{height:2px;padding:0;margin:24px 0;background:var(--softline);border:0}
table{border-spacing:0;border-collapse:collapse;display:block;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:auto}th,td{padding:6px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line)}th{text-align:left;font-weight:600}tr:nth-child(2n){background:var(--code)}
@media(max-width:640px){body{padding:0}.shell{border:0;border-radius:0}.chrome{padding:12px 16px}article{padding:16px}h2{font-size:21px}h2 img{width:21px;height:21px}pre{font-size:11px;padding:12px}sub{font-size:11px}}

<p>I'm a master's student and academic assistant at <strong>Reutlingen University</strong>, focused on applied AI. My bachelor's thesis was on <strong>prompt injection</strong>. I haven't quite left that rabbit hole.</p>
<br/>
<h2><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," width="24" height="24" alt="" /> 01 / on my desk</h2>
<p>I'm building <strong><a href="https://sixsentences.com/">SixSentences ↗</a></strong> solo. It covers paper screening, AI-led voice interviews and surveys, analysis, and LaTeX writing. I also fine-tune the transformer encoders used for screening.</p>
<p>At university, I teach programming and practical sessions on <strong>AI-assisted development with coding agents</strong>.</p>
<br/>
<h2><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," width="24" height="24" alt="" /> 02 / research notes</h2>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>Can LLMs Chain Bugs into Breaches?</strong><br />
Attack Path Discovery in Terraform.<br />
<sub>IEEE ICSME 2026 · Visions and Emerging Results · Accepted, to appear.</sub></p>
</blockquote>
<p>I'm also investigating hallucinated Terraform resources, brittle evaluation oracles, and the security of LLM-generated infrastructure.</p>
<details>
<summary>Open the research notebook</summary>
<br/>
<p><strong>Manuscript in preparation</strong><br />
<em>Hallucinated Resources, Brittle Oracles, Decoupled Security: An Empirical Study of LLM-Generated Terraform.</em></p>
<p><strong>Ongoing collaboration</strong><br />
Security evaluation of LLM-generated Terraform with J. Höll and W. Blochinger at Reutlingen University.</p>
<p><strong>B.Sc. thesis</strong><br />
<em>Prompt Injection Attacks on Transformer-Based Language Models.</em></p>
</details>
<br/>
<h2><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," width="24" height="24" alt="" /> 03 / patch log</h2>
<p>A few merged fixes to AI tooling, shown as before/after notes:</p>
<p><strong>claude-mem</strong> · <a href="https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/pull/3949">#3949 ↗</a></p>
<pre><code><span class="diff-del">- Failed memory writes could get skipped forever.</span>
<span class="diff-add">+ Keep failed observations pending.</span></code></pre>
<p><strong>omlx</strong> · <a href="https://github.com/jundot/omlx/pull/3545">#3545 ↗</a></p>
<pre><code><span class="diff-del">- Embedding responses could contain NaN / Inf.</span>
<span class="diff-add">+ Reject non-finite embeddings.</span></code></pre>
<p><strong>Logfire</strong> · <a href="https://github.com/pydantic/logfire/pull/2404">#2404 ↗</a></p>
<pre><code><span class="diff-del">- Exporter failures could deadlock logging.</span>
<span class="diff-add">+ Use a re-entrant lock.</span></code></pre>
